name: Bota Recorder
description: Control a local Bota recording pen over BLE via the existing Python gateway.

projectRoot.label: Firmware Project Root
projectRoot.help: Root directory that contains the firmware package used by the Python BLE gateway.

pythonPath.label: Python Path
pythonPath.help: Python interpreter used to launch the local Bota BLE gateway.

host.label: Gateway Host
host.help: Loopback address for the local Bota BLE gateway.

port.label: Gateway Port
port.help: HTTP port for the local Bota BLE gateway.

autoStart.label: Auto Start Gateway
autoStart.help: When enabled, OpenClaw will launch the local Python BLE gateway on first use.

startupTimeoutMs.label: Gateway Startup Timeout
startupTimeoutMs.help: How long OpenClaw should wait for the local BLE gateway to become healthy.

defaultNameContains.label: Default BLE Name Filter
defaultNameContains.help: Default BLE device-name substring used when connecting without an explicit address.
